verdict.rationale: SAM.gov issues API keys tied to accounts. It offers separate System Accounts for machine access, which must be created and approved, and data access is tiered (Public, FOUO, Sensitive) by the account's sensitivity level. That gives coarse least-privilege separation an agent could use, but scope is set per account, not per key. missing for 10: fine-grained per-key scopes or permissions, self-service issuance of multiple scoped keys for agents (System Accounts need approval), key rotation/expiry controls, agent-specific credential guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
